method: Downloaded every candidate with the repository Download-Candidate.ps1, recorded exact size and SHA-256, extracted text with Extract-CandidatePdfBatch.ps1, parsed the ACTION ITEMS section of each set of minutes, and classified by whether the committee adopted a Development Process Manual change.
precedent: Applies the established DPM Executive Committee precedent: src-087842cdf31bbd1c (September 24, 2014) was validated because it recorded substantive adopted manual changes, while src-030f7d2a680a31d4 (November 19, 2014) was excluded as routine procedural minutes.

approved_for_addition.title: Development Process Manual Executive Committee Minutes, July 16, 2014
approved_for_addition.adopted_actions: Internal rules of procedure, quorum, voting thresholds, Open Meetings policy; DPM to be amended to reflect voting results.
approved_for_addition.description: Establishes the committee's internal rules of procedure, adopting a six-member quorum, majority and unanimous voting thresholds, Open Meetings compliance, and a requirement that the Development Process Manual be amended to reflect recorded voting results.

approved_for_addition.title: Development Process Manual Executive Committee Minutes, December 17, 2014
approved_for_addition.adopted_actions: Adopted the DPM Preface and update procedure with changes.
